class.name: HTMLTableRowElement
class.brief_description: A row in an HTML table.
class.description: Cell queries use the immediate children and return stable element handles.

method.name: delete_cell
method.description: Detaches a cell and keeps its handle valid. Pass [code]-1[/code] to detach the last cell. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid index.

method.name: get_cells
method.description: Returns a tree-order snapshot of the immediate header and data cells.

method.name: insert_cell
method.description: Inserts a data cell at the given index. Pass [code]-1[/code] to append. Returns [code]null[/code] for an invalid index.

members.member: Zero-based position in the table or [code]-1[/code] when outside a table.
Zero-based position in the parent section or table. Returns [code]-1[/code] without either parent.
